newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude flirts with $23 support level.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude flirts with $23 support level.

text.p: IPE Brent futures slid towards the lower end of support levels shortly after the NYMEX open on Monday, traders said.
Jan Brent was trading down 27 cents at $23.03 a barrel at 1540 GMT, just after hitting its intraday low of $23.00.
"We're having a bit of a tussle at the moment as to whether we can hold or whether we will go lower," one trader said.
Dec gas oil was trading down $3.75 at an intraday low of $217.00 a tonne.
Traders said the market would remain uncertain until the issue of the record 865,100 tonne delivery into the expired November gas oil contract was fully resolved.
"There will be even more of a standoff until (the issue) gets resolved," a trader said.
Weak demand also contributed to the fall, although the market was watching out for the colder weather forecast for Europe and the United States in the next few days, traders said.

Independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said in its morning bulletin that mild weather in the northeast United States was expected to last one more day and that temperatures 10-15 below normal were expected by the end of the week.
